scripts.role: Publish byte-identical candidates to annotator_a, immutable review queue, and editable working folder; regenerate manifests.
scripts.important_limit: The expected count is hard-coded to 20.

scripts.role: Validate JSON Schema, field semantics, cross-record rules, and strict gold approval rules.

Validate the frozen 30-record pilot design and its human-review provenance.

scripts.role: Reusable strict gate for any versioned release using its own frozen selection, source PDFs, and page-text cache.
